calls.title: Ellipsis Health and GrowthBook
calls.summary: GrowthBook's Christian Liebenow (account manager) and Logan Bates (solutions engineer) demonstrated their feature flagging and experimentation platform to Ellipsis Health's Irene Tong (director of engineering) and Amitesh Dwivedi (product manager), addressing pain points around disjointed releases, lack of unified flag management, and the need for safe rollouts and eventual A/B testing. Next steps: Ellipsis will create a free cloud account to evaluate the platform, and GrowthBook will set up a Slack channel for ongoing support.
